summary: To migrate other role plugins, move them to plugins/<type>/ (e.g. filter_plugins to plugins/filter), update doc_fragment references to FQCN, make same-directory relative imports start with a period, and update module_utils namespaces and __init__.py imports.
questions: Where do filter_plugins from a role go in a collection?
Why do my relative imports break after moving plugins into a collection?
Do doc fragment names need to change when migrating to a collection?

answer_card.title: Migrate other role plugins
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Move each plugin, e.g. `roles/my_role/filter_plugins/*` → `plugins/filter/`.
2. Use FQCNs in docs (`mydocfrag` → `mynamespace.mycollection.mydocfrag`).
3. Relative imports must start with a period (`filename` → `./filename`).
4. Update custom `module_utils` imports to the `ansible_collections` FQCN form and fix `__init__.py` imports.
